MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_SIDE_WINDOW 0.1,0.4 a 1:1 turn is read on |a - a_P| over [near, far] x the run's median half-cycle on each side of it; no status reads them yet Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN True rule coorbital_edge_turn: a prograde 1:1 angle whose first or last run misses the turning point the filter's edge trim hides takes it from the raw angle averaged over MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_ORBITS orbits, only when it closes a cycle of a run that was no episode and the reversal holds: prominence >= MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_MIN_DEG, a reflection on a top of the averaged potential (the planet or L3), a crossing a_P and |ln out/in| <= MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_ENERGY_TOL (2006 BZ147: 960 yr, 40 yr before the end; False = no such turning point) MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_ORBITS 3.0 rule coorbital_edge_turn: the raw angle and a are averaged over this many of the body's orbital periods (a centered running mean, shorter at the record ends) before the edge reversal is read; the study's average of a 1:1 leg (it drops the ripple of one orbit and its harmonics) Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_MIN_DEG 20.0 rule coorbital_edge_turn: a reversal of the averaged raw angle in the edge trim counts when it swings at least this far on both sides, from the run's last (first) turning point and back towards the record edge [deg] Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_ENERGY_TOL 0.34 a 1:1 turn is a reflection by the averaged potential, which mirrors |a - a_P| (time reversal), when |ln(out/in)| <= this, out/in = |a - a_P| after / before it (coorbital_geometry.turn_conservation); else a kick. 0.34 = ln 1.4, the band [1/1.4, 1.4] of the study, the 90th percentile (0.331) of the turns of confirmed 1:1 cycles (rule coorbital_edge_turn; the single-leg rule G4c shares it) MMR_COORBITAL_SINGLE_LEG True rule coorbital_leg, leaf G4c: a prograde 1:1 angle without a librating episode is judged on the legs of its averaged angle outside the accepted runs (between two reversals, less than a turn, period 2 L >= the floor less CONFIDENCE_THIN_BAND): a clean leg (tadpole, horseshoe or quasi-satellite) whose local 1:1 law and energy integral pass and whose two turns reflect (|ln out/in| <= MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_ENERGY_TOL, zone <= MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_ZONE_MAX) -> transient (cap one_coorbital_leg); any one of these failing -> uncertain/one_coorbital_leg; a clean leg cut by the record edge whose observed turn reflects -> uncertain/insufficient_time (extend); both turns scatter -> non_resonant with the near-episode cap; the strongest outcome of the legs decides (False = the circulation leaf as before) MMR_COORBITAL_LEG_WINDOW_FACTOR 0.25 rule coorbital_leg: the local 1:1 law of a single leg is fitted on the leg widened by this x its length L on each side Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_LEG_CUTOFF_ORBITS 2.0 rule coorbital_leg: the leg's own cutoff is max(this x P_orb, MMR_COORBITAL_LEG_CUTOFF_FRACTION x 2 L): it drops the orbital ripple Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_LEG_CUTOFF_FRACTION 0.1 rule coorbital_leg: the leg's own cutoff is at least this x its period 2 L Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_TURN_ZONE_MAX 1.1 rule coorbital_leg: a 1:1 turn reflects only at a level the averaged potential can reverse, |a - a_P| / da_max <= this on the leg's side (da_max: the largest |da| the highest R~ before the planet or L3 ahead still reverses, coorbital_geometry.da_max); 1.1 covers 97.6 % of the turns of confirmed 1:1 cycles (q95 1.04) in the study, against 77 % of the turns of single legs MMR_COORBITAL_LEG_FORCE_GATE False rule coorbital_leg: also read a single leg whose local 1:1 law fails or has K <= 0 as a scattering. False = q-4 A literally: a failed law is one discrepancy, uncertain (7 co-orbital records differ, C1) MMR_SINGLE_HALF_LIBRATION True rule single_half_libration, leaf G4h: an angle that is not 1:1, circulating without an accepted run, whose bounded half-swing (two turning points, half-amplitude < pi, period >= the floor less CONFIDENCE_THIN_BAND) lies between passages over the top (or a passage and the record edge) and follows the resonance's own one-harmonic law a_dot = A sin sigma + B cos sigma + C (R^2 >= MMR_FORCE_R2_FAIL on each half of its window, the force turning sigma back at both turning points) -> uncertain/one_half_libration (review), at the record edge uncertain/insufficient_time (extend); without the law the circulation stays (False = the circulation leaf as before) MMR_HALF_LIBRATION_WINDOW_FACTOR 0.25 rule single_half_libration: the one-harmonic law of a half-swing is fitted on it widened by this x its length on each side Convention. MMR_RECORD_EDGE_STRETCH True rule end_arc_extend: read how sigma_f meets the record edges after circulation. At the end, a pass of >= one revolution whose stretch after its last completed revolution lasts longer than MMR_END_ARC_SLOWDOWN_FACTOR x the longest revolution of the pass and, doubled, MMR_END_ARC_MIN_FLOOR_PERIODS x the floor, with no turn of the slow center and no librating episode in it: final_regime arc (range >= pi) or stall, flag extend_time (forward), and a non_resonant circulation is capped at medium (record_ends_unresolved). At the start the mirror, and one reflection of the slow center an edge cuts (< one revolution between the turn and the edge, >= one beyond it), give the flag only (backward at the start, forward at the end); so do the clean 1:1 edge legs of leaf G4c and the edge half-librations of G4h (False = none of this) MMR_END_ARC_MIN_FLOOR_PERIODS 1.0 rule end_arc_extend: an edge stretch (slowdown or reflection) of length D counts when 2 D is at least this many periods of the angle's floor (the shortest libration it may have): the stretch holds no turn, so a cycle through it lasts at least 2 D (a 1:1 leg's 2 L is read so); a shorter one could be no cycle of this resonance [P_floor] Convention. MMR_END_ARC_SLOWDOWN_FACTOR 2.0 rule end_arc_extend: the stretch after the last completed revolution of the edge pass is a slowdown when it lasts more than this x the longest revolution of the pass (its mean rate below 1/this of the circulation's). A circulation whose rate depends on sigma alone completes the next revolution sooner than a full one takes (the bound 1), but a slowly drifting rate exceeds it a little: 2017 XF62 20 kyr 1.005, 2024 TY11 20 kyr 1.10, against 2022 BB2 11.5 Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_WELL_EPISODES True rule coorbital_well_cut: a prograde 1:1 episode ends only where sigma crosses a separatrix (a revolution of sigma_f or of the orbit-averaged raw angle). A run whose cycle bands do not overlap is accepted when every full cycle holds a minimum of the averaged potential (to within the run's turning-point prominence) and its centers stay within one turn; neighboring accepted runs join across a half-cycle that does not circulate; no regime cut (center step, stall) applies. Changes of well and of amplitude are annotations (episodes.csv marks). False = the band test, the regime cuts and the union of regimes as before MMR_COORBITAL_WELL_CORE True rule coorbital_well_core (needs MMR_COORBITAL_WELL_EPISODES): a 1:1 run the band test rejects and some of whose cycles hold no well is kept from its cores, the maximal blocks of cycles that hold one; the first core continues back and the last forward while sigma crosses neither the planet nor L3 (unless the core does), nor swings over the top, nor circulates. The core gives the cycle count (episodes.csv core_*, mark unheld); failing cycles between two cores split the run. No threshold of its own. False = such a run is rejected whole MMR_COORBITAL_RESIDENCE True rule coorbital_residence: with the wells of MMR_COORBITAL_WELL_EPISODES, every accepted 1:1 run gets an inferred residence, the stay around its core (its measured turning points) over the legs of the raw angle averaged over MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_ORBITS orbits (reversals of MMR_COORBITAL_EDGE_TURN_MIN_DEG) until a leg sweeps LIBRATION_EDGE_ARC_REV turns or the record ends, and each of its sub-regimes its own 1:1 law (episodes.csv residence_*, subregime_checks). Data only: coverage, edges, margins and the status read the core. False = none of it MMR_COORBITAL_QS_FLOOR True rule G1q: a prograde 1:1 angle whose orbit-averaged angle turns inside the quasi-satellite well of the averaged potential during a stay of >= MMR_COORBITAL_QS_TRIGGER_PERIODS loops through its turns, and that has no libration over the record, is analyzed again with the floor MMR_COORBITAL_PERIOD_FLOOR_FACTOR x P_QS (episodes centered outside the well keep the tadpole floor); kept when that pass finds a libration in the well (2010 CG236: 8 yr) Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_QS_TRIGGER_PERIODS 1.0 rule G1q: the second pass runs when the orbit-averaged angle turns in the quasi-satellite well (a reversal of at least MMR_TP_PROMINENCE_FLOOR_DEG) during a stay of >= this x the period of the loop of the averaged potential through the stay's own turns (the longest small-amplitude P_QS along it when no loop joins them): one loop is the shortest stay that turns on both sides of the well. Only the trigger: the pass is kept by its own return, force law and energy integral. The low-e well is not harmonic: 2002 PN stays 26 yr, its loop (K/K_theory 1.00) takes 17.8 yr, the loop through its turns 19.5 yr, the small-amplitude P_QS 32.5 yr Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_QS_WELL_SHARE 0.5 rule G1q: an episode counts as centered in the quasi-satellite well (and takes its floor) only where the averaged potential has that well on at least this share of the episode's samples; otherwise it keeps the tadpole floor Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_QS_MAX_BLOCKS 4000 rule G1q (cost): the 1:1 force law of the quasi-satellite pass reads the elements in blocks of P_QS,min (not longer than the angle's own P_c), but in no more than this many over the record (longer blocks then): each block may need its own table of the averaged potential (2010 CG236 over 20 kyr: 3774 blocks of 5.3 yr, 45 s; 1000 blocks of 20 yr fail its energy integral, R^2 0.11) MMR_COORBITAL_QS_RUN_FLOOR True rule coorbital_qs_run_floor (G1q pass only; needs MMR_COORBITAL_PROFILE_FLOOR and MMR_COORBITAL_QS_FLOOR): a run inside the quasi-satellite well whose turning points (on the orbit-averaged angle) all lie in that well has the floor min(the QS floor, MMR_COORBITAL_QS_LOOP_FACTOR x the loop of the averaged potential through its own turns, not below the period the pass filter keeps at gain MMR_L8_GAIN_FAIL), when its local 1:1 law has K / K_theory > 0, and the libration image of the TP prominence reads the same floor: the low-e QS well softens towards its barrier, so the small-amplitude P_QS is no lower bound (54509 YORP: 112 yr at 1 deg, 49.9 yr at 26 deg; a 50-yr QS run of 11 TPs was below the 55.7-yr QS floor). False = the QS floor for every run in the well MMR_COORBITAL_QS_LOOP_FACTOR 0.7 rule coorbital_qs_run_floor: the floor of a quasi-satellite run is this x the loop through its own turns, a prediction at its own amplitude (no margin for extrapolating from P(0), as MMR_COORBITAL_PERIOD_FLOOR_FACTOR has): counted QS runs read P / loop 0.84-1.05, synthetic oscillations faster than the Earth's force allows 0.54-0.65 (a sine at 0.76 is not separated) Convention.; also the factor of rule coorbital_pair_loop_floor MMR_COORBITAL_PAIR_LOOP_FLOOR True rule coorbital_pair_loop_floor (needs MMR_COORBITAL_PROFILE_FLOOR): a 1:1 run with a turn that is no reflection on a top (or a pair of turns no loop joins), which keeps the tadpole floor otherwise, has the floor MMR_COORBITAL_QS_LOOP_FACTOR x the median loop of its reflecting pairs whose turns are both >= MMR_COORBITAL_PAIR_LOOP_MIN_HILL Hill radii from the planet, at most the tadpole floor, when its own local 1:1 law has K / K_theory > 0 and passes the force check in full (MMR_FORCE_R2_FULL in both halves, MMR_COORBITAL_SCALE_RATIO_MAX). No threshold of its own. False = the tadpole floor for such a run MMR_COORBITAL_PAIR_LOOP_MIN_HILL 1.0 rule coorbital_pair_loop_floor: the closest a turn of a reflecting pair may lie to the planet, in Hill radii a_P (mu / 3)^(1/3) in longitude: the Hill sphere, inside which the planet, not the Sun, holds the body. The pair-loop floor asks for the run's own 1:1 law in full, so the measured force, not the averaging margin of MMR_COORBITAL_MIN_TURN_HILL, keeps out an encounter (the author 2026-11-15, 2022 RD2 c075: a horseshoe of five turns at 0.2-2.2 Hill radii, |delta a| kept at each, loops through its turns 81 yr against 76 yr observed) MMR_COORBITAL_COVERAGE_AUDIT True the 1:1 coverage audit after the policy (prograde 1:1 only; flags and columns, never a status): flag floor_above_own_loop when a floor exceeds the loop of the averaged potential through the turns of the run it rejects, flag uncovered_bounded_run when the orbit-averaged angle holds a bounded run of >= MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_MIN_HALF_CYCLES half-cycles inside the window that no counted episode or span covers; both enter review_reasons (columns aud_*). False = neither MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_MIN_SWING_DEG 10.0 coverage audit: a turning point of the orbit-averaged angle needs a reversal of at least max(this, MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_NOISE_FACTOR x its noise) (at 20 deg the 17-deg QS swing of 2015 SO2 is missed; 5 deg changes the Earth survey by 1 %) [deg] Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_NOISE_FACTOR 5.0 coverage audit: the reversal of a turning point is at least this x the noise 1.4826 MAD of the averaged angle less its own average over the same window (the jitter the average leaves; the survey sweep's value) Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_CENTRE_TOL 0.5 coverage audit: in a bounded run every turn returns near the one two half-cycles before, |x_(i+2) - x_i| <= 2 x this x the smaller neighbouring half-amplitude (Earth survey: 0.3 -> 450, 0.8 -> 479 stretches, 453 at 0.5) Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_AUDIT_MIN_HALF_CYCLES 4 coverage audit: a bounded run (and a missed stretch of it) has at least this many consecutive half-cycles: 4 is the smallest count at which the centre test is defined (two maxima and two minima); fewer inside the window is an edge stretch (columns only) Convention. MMR_FILTER_GUARD_TP_ABS 2 x2 guard: the TP counts at P_c and 2 P_c on their common interval may differ by this many (one TP at each end) or by MMR_FILTER_GUARD_TP_REL of the larger count; more is a change (filter_sensitive) Convention. MMR_FILTER_GUARD_TP_REL 0.1 x2 guard: relative tolerance of the TP counts (see MMR_FILTER_GUARD_TP_ABS) Convention. MMR_FILTER_GUARD_BOUNDARY_PERIODS 1.0 x2 guard: the decisive episode (else any accepted episode) whose start or end moves by more than this many libration periods is a change Convention. MMR_FILTER_GUARD_H_TOL 0.1 x2 guard: the median cycle energy h (separatrix 1) changing by more than this x max(1, the smaller |h|), or across 1, is a change (relative far above the separatrix: h ~ 1e4-1e7 of a far circulation moves by < 1 %) Convention. MMR_FILTER_GUARD_AMP_REL 0.2 x2 guard: the largest half-amplitude of the decisive episode against its counterpart at 2 P_c (else of the episode with the most TPs) changing by more than this fraction is a change; energy and shape are compared only when the gain at P_cyc of the 2 P_c filter is >= MMR_L8_GAIN_FULL (else not checked) Convention. MMR_FILTER_CUTOFF_YR empty explicit cutoff period overriding the rule (empty = rule) [yr] MMR_RIPPLE_REMOVE True subtract sum_j k_j dlambda_j (great inequality) from the angle when planets are saved MMR_RIPPLE_BAND_YR 300.0,3000.0 period band of the diagnostic correlation of the subtracted ripple with the angle (flt_ripple_corr) [yr] MMR_RIPPLE_RECONSTRUCTION_MAX_DEG 1.0 the ripple is subtracted when the saved angle equals the combination of the saved longitudes within this [deg]

docs.title: MMR sampling: alias branches and the unwrap
docs.text: key default meaning MMR_UNWRAP predictive 'predictive' = unwrap by the rate model from a; 'numpy' = np.unwrap (diagnostic) MMR_UNWRAP_MAX_RESID_P99_DEG 45.0 99th percentile of the per-step model error of the lambda part for a stitchable record [deg] MMR_UNWRAP_MAX_RESID_DEG 135.0 largest single per-step model error of the lambda part (pi/4 below pi) [deg] MMR_UNWRAP_SUSPECT_RESID_DEG 90.0 a step with |residual| above this is unwrap_step_suspect [deg] MMR_VARPI_REF_WINDOW_YR 5000.0 window of the varpi slope used as the slow term of the rate model [yr] MMR_JITTER_MAX_RAD 0.785 |p| de_sp/e above this (pi/4) = jitter_low_e (the osculating wobble of p varpi: a flag and a cap <= medium); undefined_phase also needs varpi itself undefined (MMR_VARPI_UNDEFINED_MAX_SHARE); locally |p| s/|z_f| = phase_undefined_local [rad] MMR_VARPI_UNDEFINED_MAX_SHARE 0.5 undefined_phase needs varpi's own (p = 1) local scatter s/|z_f| above MMR_JITTER_MAX_RAD on more than this share of the measured record (not measured: undefined_phase as before, jitter_low_e and the full angle failing) Convention. MMR_JITTER_BAND_YR 50.0 periods shorter than this make the short-period e scatter de_sp; the band of the slow vector z_f = [yr] MMR_STEP_RESOLVED_DEG 90.0 step verdict resolved: |nu| dt <= this [deg] MMR_FAR_FROM_RES_FACTOR 10.0 far_from_resonance: | - a| >= this x the a scale of the record, max(half the a range, |a(lambda_dot) - |): a libration about a needs the slow a to reach a* (no strength enters: mu e^q is not a bound) MMR_AXIS_RANGE_PERCENTILE 1.0 the a range of the rate model (nu_lo, nu_hi, alias branches, far ratio) is the [x, 100 - x] percentiles of a [%] MMR_PLANET_UNWRAP_MAX_STEP_DEG 90.0 a saved planet's n_j is the slope of its unwrapped lambda_j only when no step errs from the table rate by more than this; otherwise the table value [deg] MMR_ALIAS_NUMPY_REV_TOL 0.5 alias_np_unwrap_differs: predictive and np.unwrap revolutions differ by more [rev] MMR_ALIASED_LINE_HARMONICS 3 harmonics m of synodic waves checked for folding into [P_cyc/2, 2P_cyc] MMR_ALIASED_LINE_BAND_FACTOR 2.0 a folded synodic line is reported when its period is within [P_cyc/x, x P_cyc] MMR_RESAMPLE_STEPS_YR 0.05,0.1,0.2,0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0,2.5,5.0,10.0 round values a resample step (and smp_fold_free_step_yr) is chosen from [yr] MMR_RESAMPLE_STEPS_PER_CYCLE 20.0 recommended step <= P_cyc / this (an undersampled record and the dry-run: the shortest libration P_floor / this) MMR_EXTEND_MIN_SPAN_FACTOR 2.0 an extension asks for at least this x the record length T (the total length from the start epoch); also secular/ZLK MMR_NEXT_CHECK_SPAN_FACTOR 4.0 insufficient_time/extend: the next check is round_up(max(f_min T, min(N, this x T))), N the estimate from the period (base_extend_to_years); a budget, not a sufficiency estimate: the record is analyzed again after it; also every secular/ZLK extension (analysis.secular.extend); minimal policy clause C: a needed veto not measured for lack of length extends when its record is <= this x T, else review Convention. MMR_EXTEND_SLOW_CYCLES 3.0 insufficient_time from G5w (an unfinished slow swing in the resonance's own well): the record needs this many slow periods, N = this x P_slow + the edge trims (base_extend_to_years), instead of one cycle; a budget: 523683 2U-9, P_slow 112 kyr in 100 kyr, asks for 400 kyr, not 200 kyr (less than two cycles) Convention. MMR_EXTEND_FORCE_WINDOWS 2.0 an uncertain row whose force law (L4) has fewer than MMR_FORCE_MIN_WINDOWS windows while its last episode reaches the record end asks for t_start(last episode) + this x MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_CYCLES x P(last episode), rounded up; a budget (the action and extend_to_years only): 2003 TX9 3E+2J-10 asks for 30 kyr Convention.

docs.title: Geometry: turning points, center, episodes, jumps
docs.text: key default meaning LIBRATION_MIN_TURNING_POINTS 3 turning points of one full cycle: an episode needs this many; a secular moving center too. Changing it also changes the minimal policy's extend bound 2T / LIBRATION_MIN_TURNING_POINTS (fewer than three half-periods fit the record) LIBRATION_NEAR_EPISODE_TP_DEFICIT 1 a run that would be a librating episode but for its count (half-cycles below pi, no over-the-top neighbor, period not below the shortest libration) and lacks at most this many turning points is a near-episode: a verdict without libration gets flag near_episode, confidence <= medium; 0 = off LIBRATION_COVERAGE_PERIODS 1.0 an episode covers a record edge when it starts (ends) within this many periods of it, or when no turning point is missing at the edge of the analysis window (that gap not longer than the longest TP-to-TP step of the episode, nor than this many periods) and the stretch the filter trims off that edge is within this many periods LIBRATION_UNION_BAND_MARGIN_DEG 10.0 MMR: two consecutive librating episodes join into one libration over the record (G2, covering_union) only when the gap between them is bounded: every sample of sigma_f there lies within this margin of the band of one of the two (its center at the facing full cycle +- its half_amp_max) or of the band carried linearly between those centers (+- the larger half_amp_max), however long the gap [deg] Convention. LIBRATION_EPISODE_GAP_FACTOR 3.0 a gap between turning points above this x the median half-period splits a run LIBRATION_REGULAR_PERIOD_RATIO 2.0 a run whose center moves is judged again on its longest stretch of full periods <= this x their median (a slow edge cycle is a change of regime, not part of the stationary libration), and may drop one edge half-cycle slower than this x the median half-period LIBRATION_EDGE_ARC_REV 1.0 an exit (entry) is observed, not suspected, when the angle runs at least this many turns away from the last turning point of the last episode to the record end (from the record start to the first one) and moves monotonically there: the orbit-averaged raw angle of an MMR, sigma_f of a secular or ZLK angle; that edge is then not covered (an arc > 2 pi is not a piece of libration) [rev] Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_TOL 0.05 MMR: two opposite turning points are one closed cycle when sigma_f crosses their mid-level before the first and after the second in the same direction, a returning to within this x its swing there, the rate to within this fraction, and sigma_f crossing the mid-level between them as fast as at the first crossing, the other way (closure by phase return; 2016 CA138: 0.08 %, 0.2 %, 0.1 %) Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_PERIOD_TOL 0.25 MMR: the phase return also needs (t_b - t_a) / (2 x the time between the two turning points) within 1 +- this (the quarter-period symmetry of a cycle; a circulation creeping back between two turns gives ~0.5; 2016 CA138: 1.00) Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_IDENTITY_CORR_MIN 0.9 MMR: the phase return also needs corr(sigma_dot, sign(c) (a - mean a)) >= this between the two crossings (a kinematic back-swing with a flat a is no cycle); the value of MMR_IDENTITY_CORR_MIN LIBRATION_RETURN_LEVELS 19 MMR: the phase return of two opposite turning points is tried at the mid-level and at the levels k / (n + 1) of their swing, k = 1..n, with the same conditions, a level counting only inside a band of closing levels (LIBRATION_RETURN_MID_BAND_LEVELS for the mid-level, LIBRATION_RETURN_BAND_LEVELS for another); the mid-level is kept when it counts, else the best match (the mid-level is a convention, any level is a section the cycle crosses twice; 164207 never crosses its mid-level before the horseshoe turn); 0 or 1 = the mid-level only, alone Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_BAND_LEVELS 2 MMR: a level other than the mid-level closes a cycle by its phase return only inside at least this many consecutive closing levels of LIBRATION_RETURN_LEVELS (the mismatches change continuously with the level, a real return holds over a band of sections; 2025 RB7 at 1 kyr closes at 0.20-0.25, 164207 at 0.15-0.20) Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_MID_BAND_LEVELS 2 MMR: the mid-level closes a cycle by its phase return inside at least this many consecutive closing levels of LIBRATION_RETURN_LEVELS (2: one closing neighbor), counted over the observable levels only: a level whose crossing may lie beyond the record neither closes nor breaks the band, so a mid-level without an observable neighbor closes alone (a 400-yr cosine on -104..304 yr); 1 = the mid-level alone Convention. LIBRATION_RETURN_CYCLE_CAPS_MEDIUM True MMR: a verdict that rests on a cycle closed only by its phase return (two turning points) has confidence <= medium (cap one_return_cycle) Convention. LIBRATION_REGIME_CUTS True MMR: a run whose center moves is cut at a center step between two measured regimes or at a stall of its slow center (524522 1V-1, 385266 16N-27); off: such a run stays one rejected run Convention. LIBRATION_STALL_MIN_CYCLES 3 MMR: a run whose center moves is cut at a stall of its slow center: at least this many independent full cycles whose midpoints move less per period than the cycles swing (385266 16N-27, 55-95 kyr); a steady drift has none Convention. LIBRATION_FRAME_JOIN True MMR: two runs broken by one half-cycle over the top in sigma are one run when that half-cycle stays below the top in psi = sigma - c(t) of the moving well and the joined run passes the band test (82831 13M-24); off: every over-the-top half-cycle in sigma breaks the run Convention. LIBRATION_STALL_JOIN True MMR: after a stall cut, a leftover piece next to the stall joins it when its cycles have the stall's period and the joined piece passes the band test (385266 16N-27, 56.6-98.7 kyr); off: the leftover stays a piece of its own Convention. LIBRATION_REGIME_CUT_MARKS True MMR: two neighboring accepted pieces of a center-step or stall cut are one episode when the last full cycle before the cut and the first after it share a band (m +- A overlap > 0) and a period (ratio <= LIBRATION_REGULAR_PERIOD_RATIO): sigma stays in one libration region, and the cut becomes a mark (episodes.csv marks centre_step@t0:t1, stall@t0:t1); disjoint bands stay cut (2013 VA14 60 kyr); off: every standing regime cut is a boundary Convention. LIBRATION_CENTRE_CYCLES 3.0 the center is the angle smoothed over this many cycles LIBRATION_CENTRE_TP_PROMINENCE_DEG 10.0 floor of the prominence of a center turn (4x the center noise A/82) [deg] LIBRATION_CENTRE_TP_FACTOR 2.0 a center turn also needs this x the turning-point prominence LIBRATION_CENTRE_SCALE_TP_AT_CENTRE True MMR G2c: the analysis at the scale of the center takes its turning points at the center-turn prominence p_c (MMR_TP_PROMINENCE_FLOOR_DEG raised to p_c there): the turns the precheck that qualified the scale reads: a swing below p_c is no turn of the center there (residue of the fast component W_c attenuates, or a libration too small for this scale, which the fine scale judges) (2003 TX9 3E+2J-10); off: the floor of the fine scale MMR_SCALE_LADDER 0.71,0.5,0.35,0.25,0.18,0.125 G2c scale ladder: the shorter cutoffs tried below a slow libration found at the center scale W_c, as fractions of P_slow / FILTER_MIN_LIBRATION_CUTOFFS (steps of sqrt 2, so neighboring rungs are close enough to compare); a rung is kept only above LIBRATION_CENTRE_CYCLES x P_fast (P_fast: the shortest full period of the fine turning points) and only when the W_c window holds fewer than LIBRATION_CENTRE_MIN_ESTIMATES slow periods; empty = off (385533 7N-12: 22.7 kyr -> 7.95 kyr) Convention. MMR_SCALE_TP_TIME_TOL 0.1 G2c scale ladder: a rung keeps the slow extrema of W_c and of the neighboring rung when, in their common window, the turning points at the center prominence agree in number and kind and each moves by at most this x P_slow (the 21 G2c rows of the benchmark: the largest shift on a rung that keeps the count is 0.022; a fast wave that reaches p_c adds turning points instead) Convention. LIBRATION_CENTRE_RETURNS_MODULATED 3 a bounded center turning back this many times is modulated, not drift (secular and ZLK angles: once is enough under SECULAR_TURNING_CENTRE, ZLK_TURNING_CENTRE) LIBRATION_CENTRE_MIN_ESTIMATES 2 a stationary center needs this many independent full cycles (no shared half-cycle; every band overlapping); with fewer (3 TPs = one cycle, one center) the episode is accepted but its center is not measured (L6 thin) LIBRATION_MODULATED_RANGE_MAX_RAD 3.141592653589793 modulated: range of the center below this [rad] LIBRATION_SLIP_TOLERANCE 0.2 a slip is a step of 2 pi (1 +- this) of the oscillation midpoint Convention. LIBRATION_SLIP_MIN_DURATION_T0 0.5 a slip faster than this x T0 is an unwrap error (the angle cannot pass the top faster) LIBRATION_PATTERN_A_MIN_SLIPS 2 pattern A needs at least this many slips LIBRATION_PATTERN_A_MIN_AMP_DEG 60.0 without a measured zone, pattern-A pieces need this amplitude (J/J_s ~ 0.3) [deg] Convention. LIBRATION_STALL_PHASE_TOL_DEG 30.0 pattern B: rate minimum within this of the potential top [deg] LIBRATION_STALL_REV_FRACTION 0.75 pattern B: this fraction of revolutions has the rate minimum at the top Convention. LIBRATION_STALL_RATE_TOL 0.2 |r_min - r_pend(h)| above this = stall_rate_inconsistent (flag only) LIBRATION_DRIFT_MIN_WINDOW_FRACTION 0.5 drift: rejected centre_moves runs cover at least this fraction of the window LIBRATION_CIRCULATION_NET_REV 2.0 G4b: the angle circulates when the slow center advances by at least this many revolutions net over the window (|c(t1) - c(t0)| / 2pi), even when its largest monotone pass stays below one (a staircase with small step-backs); also in the angle word of K2 (142694 1V+3S-7 200 kyr, 2.75 rev: a circulation; 21028 7E-10M-6, 1.81 rev: a drift) Convention. LIBRATION_JUMP_NOISE_FACTOR 8.0 a jump candidate exceeds this many robust std of the slow-variable increments LIBRATION_JUMP_DH_MIN 0.1 a jump changes the cycle energy h by more than max(2 sigma_h, this) LIBRATION_JUMP_CYCLES 2 cycles compared on each side of a jump candidate LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP True G2a (MMR, not 1:1): an accepted run whose half-amplitudes step between two separated bands, with the swing of a and the cycle energy changing the same way within one half-cycle, is cut there as at a confirmed jump of a (an impulse: a close encounter puts the orbit on another energy level; 2003 TX9 3E+2J-10 at the Mars encounters of 6.5-6.9 kyr); off: such a run stays one episode Convention. LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_MIN_HALF_CYCLES 2 G2a: half-cycles on each side of the transitional half-cycle (2 = one closed cycle) LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_SEPARATION 2.0 G2a: the two bands of half-amplitudes are separated: the smallest on the larger side over the largest on the smaller side is at least this (an adiabatic decay needs an e-folding of 1.5 cycles to reach 2 across one excluded half-cycle) LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_RATIO 3.0 G2a: ratio of the median half-amplitudes of the two sides LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_A_RATIO 1.5 G2a: the swing of a (std of a_f on each side at the record's cutoff) changes the same way by at least this factor (delta a ~ sigma_dot; 74729 1J+6S-1: a sigma step that a does not show, ratio 0.37) LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_CYCLES 1 G2a: cycles of the energy analysis on each side that confirm the step (|dh| > max(2 sigma_h, LIBRATION_JUMP_DH_MIN), the sign of the amplitude change); fewer than LIBRATION_JUMP_CYCLES on a side makes the split provisional (cap action_step_provisional, confidence <= medium) LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_PERIOD_TOL 0.2 G2a test 7: every disjoint cycle of both sides has T_obs/T_pred within this of 1, T_pred the period of the loop of the cycle's own energy, in the well that holds it, of V(sigma) fitted (as V_E) on the cycles of the larger swings (held out: each of them in V of the others); and the two sides' median periods differ by more than this (else one forcing frequency explains both: in a nearly harmonic V every loop has one period). As SEPARATRIX_PERIOD_TOL for R0 LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_TP_TOL 0.2 G2a test 7: the observed extremes of sigma of every cycle lie within this x its half-swing of the turning points of the loop of its energy (a swing off the minimum of V is no libration in V). In the harmonic limit the half-width at a given energy scales as the period, so this equals LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_PERIOD_TOL LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_ENERGY_DRIFT 0.5 G2a test 7: on each side the cycle energies in V spread by at most this x the step of the energy between the sides (between impulses the energy of a libration stays put; at 0.5 the two bands are apart by at least half the step, as the half-amplitude bands of LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_SEPARATION) LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_CUTOFFS 0.075,0.1,0.15 G2a test 7 holds at every shape cutoff C = f x the shorter side period of this list, with the same number of wells (the numbers reported at the middle one): a factor 2, lighter than SEPARATRIX_CUTOFF_CYCLES, since the test reads turning points and a second well, which live in the high harmonics of a swing across a barrier (a double well integrated and kicked: T_obs/T_pred 0.994 at 0.1, 0.911 at 0.2, the second well lost at 0.3); the rate's noise sets the floor (V_E R^2 >= SEPARATRIX_VE_R2_MIN). A well or a law one cutoff alone gives is the filter's LIBRATION_ACTION_STEP_MAX_PERIODS 1.0 G2a: the transitional half-cycle lasts at most this many of the shorter median full period of the two sides LIBRATION_JUMP_TAU_CUTOFFS 2.0 jump locator baseline tau >= this x P_c LIBRATION_JUMP_TAU_STEPS 5.0 jump locator baseline tau >= this x the output step LIBRATION_JUMP_EDGE_PERIODS 1.0 a jump candidate needs max(tau, this x P_cyc) of the window on each side to be confirmed; closer to an edge it is kept as jump_at_edge and cuts nothing MMR_TP_PROMINENCE_FLOOR_DEG 1.0 turning-point prominence floor: twice the synodic leak after the filter [deg] MMR_TP_RIPPLE_FACTOR 4.0 prominence >= this x the unremoved ripple half-amplitude or the part of sigma_f faster than MMR_LIBRATION_PERIOD_MIN_YR (95th percentile, the image of the libration runs through the two filters taken out first; a wave of half-amplitude r gives turns <= 2r)

docs.title: Energy and the separatrix zone
docs.text: key default meaning SEPARATRIX_HARMONICS_MAX 2 harmonics of V(sigma): asymmetric external 1:N need 2 SEPARATRIX_HARMONIC_GAIN 0.2 the second harmonic is kept when R^2 of V_E grows by this SEPARATRIX_PERIOD_TOL 0.2 period-energy law: |median T_obs/T_pend - 1| <= this (pendula 0.9-1.1, kinematics 0.61) SEPARATRIX_PHASE_COHERENCE 0.9 fixed well: coherence of the stable point over windows (potential 0.95-0.99, kinematics 0.71) SEPARATRIX_VEVF_R_MIN 0.9 R0 with the slow variable: correlation of V_E and V_F in a window SEPARATRIX_VEVF_FRACTION 0.666 R0 with the slow variable: fraction of the eligible windows where V_E ~ V_F (a window is eligible when sigma swings >= MMR_A_RESPONSE_MIN_AMP_DEG in it or turns; none eligible: not_measured) SEPARATRIX_VF_FREE_CONSTANT False R0 with a: V_F fits c a_dot = -m V'(phi) + C and drops C. Off: no free constant (a periodic V has no mean force over a closed cycle; on a ~100-deg arc the constant is nearly collinear with the harmonics and moved 137295 1N-2's V_F well 279 -> 338 deg), and a moving frame subtracts its own acceleration s'' from c a_dot instead SEPARATRIX_VF_PERIOD_LAW True R0 with a (the V_E ~ V_F correlation route, not the 1:1 energy integral): V_F must also carry the observed period, the median T_obs/T_pred(V_F) over the eligible compared cycles within SEPARATRIX_PERIOD_TOL of 1 (T_pred at the cycle's energy recomputed in V_F; a correlation does not see a scale factor between V_E and V_F: a force 10x too strong correlates 1.00 and gives a period law 3.4); no finite law: not_measured. Off: the correlation alone, for comparison SEPARATRIX_VEVF_ARC True R0 with a: V_E and V_F of a window are compared on the arc of phi the window visits (outside it both are extrapolations); off: on the full circle SEPARATRIX_ARC_PAD_DEG 0.0 R0 with a: the visited arc of SEPARATRIX_VEVF_ARC is widened by this on each side (a full turn: the circle) [deg] Convention. SEPARATRIX_HOLDOUT_GAIN 0.02 R0 with a: a window's V_E (and V_F with it) takes one more harmonic when that raises the held-out R^2 of rate^2 = 2E - 2V (fitted on one half of the window in time, predicted on the other, both ways) by this (over 6564 windows of 126 R0 rows the gain's median is 0.008, its 70th percentile 0.02; 137295 1N-2's asymmetric well gains 0.06-0.075; 0.01 and 0.02 give the same R0 everywhere there) Convention. SEPARATRIX_SIGMA_MARGIN 2.0 margin in sigma_h when a cycle is put into a zone class SEPARATRIX_SIGMA_FLOOR 0.02 floor of the cycle-to-cycle energy scatter sigma_h SEPARATRIX_TREND_SIGMA 3.0 trend mechanism: slope of J/J_s over cycles significant at this many sigma SEPARATRIX_PERMUTATION_P_MAX 0.05 pulsation mechanism: cyclic-shift p-value below this Convention. SEPARATRIX_LAYER_ADIABATICITY_MIN 0.5 layer mechanism: crossings at an adiabaticity lambda above this are the chaotic layer's own (no adiabatic invariant) SEPARATRIX_NEAR_ZONE_WIDTHS 1.5 near_separatrix_energy flag: revolutions within this many zone widths above the zone MMR_EXIT_AND_CAPTURE_LIFTS_UNEXPLAINED True the mark exit_and_capture lifts the cap transient_unexplained: an angle that left its libration and came back is the transient the record shows even without a named mechanism Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_LIFTS_UNEXPLAINED True a 1:1 angle gets no cap transient_unexplained: the pendulum separatrix model that names a mechanism does not apply to it, its crossings are close encounters (2026 FW12) Convention. SEPARATRIX_CUTOFF_CYCLES 0.2 V_E, V_F, the modulation and the zone read sigma and a smoothed at max(P_c, this x P_cyc) (G(P_cyc) 0.998) SEPARATRIX_VE_R2_MIN 0.7 R0 is measured only when V_E explains this share of sigma_dot^2 within the cycles Convention. MMR_ZONE_METHOD numeric zone the separatrix reaches: 'numeric' (modulated pendulum), 'eq_only', 'adiabatic' MMR_SEPARATRIX_AVGPOT_TP_MAX 40 two-body angle with its planet saved: the energy of each turning point is read in the averaged potential at its own time, h = ((sigma_TP) - _min) / (_barrier - _min); at most this many evenly chosen turning points are evaluated (cost: one profile each, ~0.02 s), the others interpolated in time; as many even times of the record give the mean separatrix action that carries their J/J_s(t) to the zone's J/ MMR_ZONE_J_MIN 0.1 smallest initial action J0/ of the zone grid MMR_ZONE_J_STEP 0.025 step of the zone grid in J0/ and in h0 MMR_ZONE_H_MAX 2.0 largest initial energy h0 on the rotation side of the zone grid MMR_ZONE_PHASES 16 start phases per modulation period in the zone grid MMR_ZONE_RTOL 1e-09 relative tolerance of the DOP853 zone trajectories MMR_ZONE_ADIABATIC_LAMBDA_MAX 0.1 below this adiabaticity the numeric zone is checked against the adiabatic edge MMR_ZONE_ADIABATIC_TOL 0.05 numeric vs adiabatic J_lo differing by more = zone_numeric_mismatch

docs.title: MMR physics: response of a, force law, identity, kinematics
docs.text: key default meaning MMR_A_RESPONSE_MIN_AMP_DEG 45.0 below this amplitude sine and line differ < 10% (A^2/6): harmonic force law not_measured (not the 1:1 law) [deg] Convention. SEPARATRIX_R0_EPISODES True R0 not measured over the record (one V_E pooled over every cycle mixes regimes) is read inside each accepted episode with two disjoint full cycles, at its own period and frame, thresholds unchanged; lift-only: pass when some episode passes and none fails MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_CYCLES 3.5 force-law fit window in cycles (phase defined, force ~ constant) MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_STEP 0.5 step of the force-law windows as a fraction of the window MMR_FORCE_MIN_WINDOWS 2 fewer force-law windows = not_measured MMR_FORCE_R2_FULL 0.7 force law passes with R^2 >= this in both halves Convention. MMR_FORCE_R2_FAIL 0.4 force law fails with R^2 below this under both laws Convention. MMR_FORCE_PHASE_TOL_DEG 30.0 floor of the expected spread of phi0 (the column rsp_phi0_tol_deg only) [deg] MMR_FORCE_MULTI_GAIN 0.1 the multiplet law is taken when its R^2 exceeds the single one by this MMR_FORCE_COEF_COH_MIN 0.8 multiplet law: coherence of the leading complex coefficients over windows MMR_FORCE_POWER_SHARE 0.8 the leading multiplet terms carry this share of the fitted power MMR_FORCE_CONTAMINATION lattice 'lattice' = a measured harmonic force law is not_measured (contamination) when a forced line of the angle's lattice lies within 1/(MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_CYCLES P) of 1/P (the fit cannot tell the two apart; it never makes a libration dynamic); 'off' MMR_RESPONSE_CUTOFF_CYCLES 0.1 identity, force law, potentials use sigma, a smoothed at max(P_c, this x P_cyc): derivatives amplify what P_c leaks; 0.1 keeps the cycle and its first 5 harmonics (G(2 cutoffs) = 0.94, as FILTER_MIN_LIBRATION_CUTOFFS) and costs an exact pendulum R^2 < 0.01 up to 178 deg; 0.15-0.2 bend the law near the separatrix (F[sin sigma] != sin F[sigma]) MMR_RESPONSE_LINE_AMP_FRAC 0.5 harmonic force law (L4): a line of a_dot (not a harmonic P_e/k of the libration) with an amplitude of at least this x the force K of the first fit, in the series the law reads, raises the response cutoff of that measurement (2004 TK14 31M-34: 64 yr at 0.9 K; 433 Eros 47M-44: 83 yr at 1.5 K) MMR_RESPONSE_LINE_MARGIN 1.5 such a line raises the response cutoff to this x its period (G = 0.16 of the line left in a, 2nd-order filtfilt) MMR_RESPONSE_MAX_FRACTION 4.0 the response cutoff raised by a line stays at or below the period of the measurement / this (P_e/4 keeps G = 0.996 of the cycle; a slower line is left in) MMR_RESPONSE_LINE_BAND_CUTOFFS 0.5 lines of a_dot are searched from this x the base response cutoff up to P_e/2: a line faster than the cutoff leaks through it (2004 TK14: 64 yr under a 75-yr cutoff keeps 0.9 K); below half the cutoff the filter leaves < 6 % MMR_FORCE_NULL_SHIFTS 8 null test of a force law whose cutoff a line raised: R^2 of the same law with a_dot shifted in time (not wrapped) by this many lags (m + 1/4) P_e and (m + 3/4) P_e, alternately forward and back, m >= 1 whole periods spread up to half the record; its largest value is the null R^2 (whole or half periods alone keep a steady libration in phase) MMR_FORCE_NULL_GAIN 0.2 a force law whose cutoff a line raised passes only with R^2 at least this above the null R^2 (433 Eros 47M-44: 0.6-0.8 against 0.15-0.35) Convention. MMR_FORCE_HARMONICS_MAX 2 a failed or thin harmonic force law (L4) is fitted again with up to this many harmonics of the angle, a_dot = sum_k [A_k sin k sigma + B_k cos k sigma] + C, the force of the V(sigma) R0 fits (as SEPARATRIX_HARMONICS_MAX; a double well or a flat bottom): taken when N >= 2 gains MMR_FORCE_MULTI_GAIN, its coefficients are coherent (MMR_FORCE_COEF_COH_MIN), it beats the shifted null by MMR_FORCE_NULL_GAIN and the law fitted on the samples of the windows before the middle of their span predicts those after it (and the reverse) with R^2 >= MMR_FORCE_R2_FAIL; it lifts L4, never lowers it; 1 = off MMR_DIRECT_FORCE_LAW True where the harmonic force law (L4) fails or passes thin on a two-body, non-1:1 angle with a direct strength, the theoretical a_dot of the directly averaged disturbing function (the planet's real mass, each window's elements) and the observed a_dot, low-passed identically at MMR_DIRECT_FORCE_CUTOFF_CYCLES x P_large, are compared with one free scale s per window: it lifts L4 (cap force_law_theory_only, <= medium) when the smaller half R^2 >= MMR_FORCE_R2_FAIL (thin below MMR_FORCE_R2_FULL), every s lies in [1/sqrt(r), sqrt(r)] (r = MMR_STRENGTH_CHECK_RATIO), R^2 beats the time-shifted null by MMR_FORCE_NULL_GAIN and two windows share no sample; never lowers L4, never makes an episode (59358 8N-13: lattice line 13 P_N in a_dot) MMR_DIRECT_FORCE_CUTOFF_CYCLES 0.35 direct force law: both a_dot are low-passed at this x P_large, and P_large is the fixed point of the period of the turns of sigma low-passed at this x P (keeps the cycle at G = 0.985, a line at P/2 at 0.81, removes faster lines that P_c lets through; 0.25 never leaves the 4.4-kyr period of 59358 8N-13, 0.35 and 0.5 reach its 8.8-kyr swing with the same verdict); the turns count as large when the TP count at twice the cutoff stays within MMR_FILTER_GUARD_TP_REL, and F then reads the strength of the large turns Convention. MMR_DIRECT_FORCE_SNAPSHOTS 5 direct force law (cost): the averaged profile d/dsigma is computed in at most this many windows, evenly chosen; every window reads the nearest one (each profile at most MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_MAX_KERNELS kernels) MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_CAP_RATIO 0.0 the record itself lifts the cap short_period_aliased only when the fast residual of sigma_f (p95, flt_fast_residual_deg) is at most this x the decisive episode's median half-amplitude and the short-period scatter of a passes MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_A_RATIO; 0 = never: the record cannot bound a line folded into a, only a finely sampled pilot measures it (0.1 lifted it on 2004 TK14 31M-34 and 433 47M-44, whose verdicts the folded lines in a change) Convention. MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_CAP_CIRCULATION False the cap short_period_aliased also on a circulation (angle word circulation, reason circulation or alias; kinematic_drift, no_resonant_potential and a circulation with forced-wave runs (F6, its failed identity reads a) keep it); off: a circulation reads neither the identity nor the force law, which the folded lines in a spoil, and the folded lines move sigma_f by <= 0.024 of a half-amplitude (47 fine reruns), so they cannot turn a libration into a circulation; the flag stays (1627 3V-4M-7, 285637 3M+7J-6, 1999 UQ 7E+2M-9) Convention. MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_A_RATIO 0.5 flag a_short_period_scatter (a warning, no cap by itself) on a record whose step folds short periods: its short-period scatter of a (smp_da_short_period_au, periods below MMR_JITTER_BAND_YR) above this x the a half-excursion of the decisive episode (ep_a_excursion_meas_au); the folded lines reach the a-based checks (identity, force law) there (2003 TG2, 2004 TK14, 2003 UC22 and 433 lose their verdict with folded errors of 0.59-1.65 x that excursion, no row at <= 0.56 does). A proxy, not a bound: a line folded to centuries is nearly invisible to it. With MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_CAP_RATIO > 0 it also keeps the cap; the same comparison gates MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_A_UNMEASURED Convention. MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_A_UNMEASURED True on a record whose step folds short periods (flag short_period_aliased), a failed force law (L4) and identity (L3), which read a, count as not_measured in the status tree and the confidence when the strength by direct averaging passes and the short-period scatter of a exceeds MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_A_RATIO x the decisive a half-excursion; a fail never becomes a pass and the cap stays (433 47M-44, 2003 UC22 16M-27 and 2004 TK14 31M-34 at 5 yr keep their verdict at 0.5 yr, where L3 and L4 pass; 2001 ND13 1V-3, scatter 0.09, keeps its failed L4, which its fine rerun confirms) Convention. MMR_SHORT_PERIOD_HARMONICS 2 harmonics m / P (m = 1..this) of P_orb and of the P_syn of the angle's planets that the step may fold: a line folded slower than the angle's period floor (smp_folded_slowest_yr) sets the flag and the cap short_period_aliased also below the fundamental step min(P) / 2 (P_orb 12 yr at a 5.999-yr step folds its second harmonic to 36 kyr). Only m <= this is searched: P_orb 12 yr at 4.002 yr folds its third harmonic to 8 kyr and stays unflagged at 2 (the record bounds no harmonic's amplitude, so the count is a convention); 0 = the fundamental step alone Convention. MMR_COORBITAL_GRID_POINTS 720 co-orbital (1:1) law: points of the theta grid and of the trapezoidal average over the planet's longitude (720 = 0.5 deg; the average converges at 360, the grid interpolates the near-encounter peaks to ~5 % rms) MMR_COORBITAL_RECORD_TABLES_MB 140.0 co-orbital law (memory): the tables of the averaged potential kept for the analysis of one record, in bytes of their arrays (17.3 kB each at 720 points: 140 MB hold 8101); a table beyond them is computed again when a later pass needs it (2010 CG236 over 20 kyr needs 7909, 137 MB, at 7 ms each). A bound in bytes holds at any MMR_COORBITAL_GRID_POINTS. It bounds this store only, not the process: the shared cache of 512 tables, the figure and the FFT workspaces come on top, and a process keeps the memory of its largest record (the benchmark tools recycle their workers, reclassify --tasks-per-worker) [MB] MMR_COORBITAL_SOFTENING_HILL 0.1 co-orbital law: the direct term is softened at this many Hill radii a_P (mu/3)^(1/3), so that an exact orbit crossing stays finite (the averaging does not describe the motion inside the Hill sphere; at 1 r_H the fitted K / K_theory of close-approaching horseshoes rises by 10-20 %, at 0.1 it is within 2 % of no softening) MMR_COORBITAL_RETABULATE_E 0.005 co-orbital law: a new table of the averaged potential when the eccentricity vector e exp(i omega) of the body or the planet moved by more than this MMR_COORBITAL_RETABULATE_INC_DEG 0.5 co-orbital law: a new table when the inclination vector sin i exp(i Omega) of the body or the planet moved by more than sin of this [deg] MMR_COORBITAL_SCALE_RATIO_MAX 3.0 co-orbital law passes only with the fitted force K / K_theory in [1/this, this] (K_theory = 1: the model holds the planet's mass; a negative K pushes a the wrong way) Convention. MMR_IDENTITY_SLOPE_TOL 0.2 identity: |slope/c - 1| <= this MMR_IDENTITY_CORR_MIN 0.9 identity: correlation of sigma_dot and a >= this MMR_FORCED_WAVE_LINE_ALONE False an accepted episode whose period sits on a forced line of the lattice is a forced wave, no episode of the angle, even when its identity does not fail (the line alone); off: the line needs the failed identity, since a chance coincidence with a line happens for 6-17 % of the force laws (482824 19N-32: line 3N-5 with the identity passing at slope/c 1.00) Convention. MMR_FORCED_WAVE_STRENGTH True marking only: on a row that rule 5s decided (non_resonant/implausible_strength) every accepted episode is stored as a forced wave with the route strength (episodes.csv forced_wave, the figure): its period needs a force >= MMR_STRENGTH_IMPLAUSIBLE_RATIO x the one the disturbing function gives, so it is no libration of this angle; the name of that ground, not a driver found. Nothing is measured again: status, word, reason and level are the same either way MMR_FORCED_WAVE_BACKGROUND True an accepted episode below MMR_A_RESPONSE_MIN_AMP_DEG is a forced wave when, at its own period, the envelopes of sigma and a inside it stay within the band the same steady wave shows around it (mmr.background_wave): a libration adds its own swing, a forced wave runs on unchanged. Every counted episode forced: veto forced_wave; some: they leave the count. Not for a 1:1 angle MMR_FORCED_WAVE_REFERENCE_PERIODS 12.0 the background of the forced-wave test reaches this many of the episode's periods on each side Convention. MMR_FORCED_WAVE_MIN_REFERENCE_PERIODS 4.0 the background of the forced-wave test must hold at least this many periods outside every accepted run, else not measured Convention. MMR_FORCED_WAVE_ENVELOPE_QUANTILE 0.9 the band of the background wave's envelope the episode must stay in: its quantiles 1 - q and q, widened by CONFIDENCE_THIN_BAND Convention. MMR_RIPPLE_ON_ARC True an accepted episode with half-amplitude below MMR_A_RESPONSE_MIN_AMP_DEG (L4 and R0 not measurable) whose identity does not pass (fails or not measured), on a record whose slow center turns back once or twice within one revolution (an unfinished slow swing), is an unconfirmed ripple, no episode of the angle (episodes.csv forced_wave unconfirmed_ripple): G5a/G6 read the slow center (insufficient_time, extend). Never a record-covering episode nor a 1:1 angle; a real small libration keeps its passing identity (2004 YG1 9M-10J-4) MMR_SLOW_SWING_IN_WELL True G5w: a slow center that turns back twice within one revolution, whose half-swing between the turns passes the slow identity and whose a swing and period 2 (t2 - t1) agree with the directly averaged pendulum at its amplitude within sqrt(MMR_STRENGTH_CHECK_RATIO), is an unfinished slow libration: insufficient_time/arc, not drift nor few_cycles (523683 2U-9); unmeasured (one turn, three-body, 1:1) keeps the old reading (the drift of 101703 and 142694 1V+3S-7) MMR_SLOW_SCALE_REPORT True store the slower libration of the center at its own scale: the runs G2c finds at the center scale W_c (covering the record or not; episodes.csv scale=slow), else the turns of the slow center of a librating angle; its period, cycles, identity, B1, nearest secular period and cause with a level (identified / possible / unknown; columns slow_*). A description: only K3s reads it MMR_SECULAR_CYCLE_KINEMATIC True K3s : a non_resonant circulation whose slow scale has the period of a secular cycle (pi/|omega_dot| or 2 pi/|g - g_j| within MMR_KIN_PERIOD_TOL) and fails its own identity is a kinematic libration (origin_detail secular_cycle), whatever B1 or a thin L4; the status and a libration row never change (37087 3J+8S-3); needs MMR_SLOW_SCALE_REPORT MMR_B1_RATIO_MIN 0.1 a carries < this of the needed amplitude: the oscillation sits in the varpi part MMR_B1_BAND_FACTOR 2.0 B1 compares a and sigma_dot / |c| in the band [P/f, f P] around the cycle period P (the libration and its wandering period; the identity holds there harmonic by harmonic) Convention. MMR_KIN_CORR_MIN 0.9 kinematic: slow sigma follows p varpi with correlation >= this Convention. MMR_KIN_SLOW_R2_MAX 0.2 kinematic: slow a_dot answers sin sigma_slow with R^2 <= this Convention. MMR_KIN_MIN_POINTS 3 independent points needed for the kinematic correlations: K1's slow angle (length / center window) and K2's slow center ((window - 2 W_c) / W_c); fewer, and the correlation is not measured MMR_KIN_PERIOD_TOL 0.1 origin_detail: the angle period matches the e-cycle, the 2 omega cycle or a planetary ripple within this fraction MMR_KIN_RIPPLE_SHARE_MAX 0.5 kinematic drift of the slow center (K2): the largest swing of a librating episode (2 x its largest half-amplitude) stays below this x the range of the slow center, so the episodes are a ripple on the drift, not the libration (21028 7E-10M-6: 117 deg against 741 deg, 0.16; the Hilda 153 3J-2: 0.95) Convention. MMR_KINEMATIC_DRIFT_WORD True a verdict non_resonant/kinematic_drift of K2 reports the angle word of its slow center, not of the ripple the geometry reads as episodes: drift, or circulation when the center passes a revolution in one direction (G4) (21028 7E-10M-6: a drift; 2897 35S-4: 10.8 rev, a circulation); off: the geometry word (episodic) stays Convention. MMR_KIN_DRIFT_SHIFT_RATIO 1.0 a kinematic libration (step 3, B1 or the kinematic cycle) whose decisive episode moves its center by more than this x its mean amplitude (L6) is decided as K2: non_resonant/kinematic_drift with the slow center's word, drift or circulation (62243 1M-4J-1, L6 1.82: a drift) Convention. MMR_KIN_B1_CLEAR 0.01 K1e, the measured physics of a kinematic libration: a carries less than this of the amplitude a pendulum would need (B1 ratio), with the episode's sigma following p varpi (K1 on the episode >= MMR_KIN_CORR_MIN) and its period at a secular one (within MMR_KIN_PERIOD_TOL); then the kinematic verdict may reach high. Far below MMR_B1_RATIO_MIN: a flat a, not a weak pendulum (285637 3M+7J-6: 6e-5; 481085 7E-10M-6: 3.2e-3; 41588 3J+9S-2: 0.095 stays medium) Convention. MMR_B5_RATIO_FULL 2.0 slow libration excluded with a full margin: center rate >= this x the bound MMR_B5_EXACT_SIGMA 2.0 exact commensurability: |nu_c| < this x its error MMR_C4_RATIO_FULL 1.5 C4 full: <|sigma_dot|> / (2 omega0_K) >= this

docs.title: MMR subresonances and the owner search
docs.text: key default meaning MMR_SUBRESONANCE_STRENGTH_REL_MIN 0.001 test E': a member's d'Alembert factor prod x^|c| (x = e, e_P, sin i/2, sin i_P/2) is at least this x that of the strongest term of the same commensurability (its pendulum is then <= 1/sqrt(this) ~ 30 times slower) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_NODAL_INC_MIN_DEG 10.0 members with node coefficients are enumerated when the median inclination to the invariable plane reaches this (their factor against the planar one of the same degree is (sin(i/2) / e)^2) [deg] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_RANGE_RATIO 0.5 candidate: its center range <= this x the range of the catalog angle center MMR_SUBRESONANCE_RATE_FLOOR_RAD_KYR 0.02 candidate: |center rate| <= max(2 sigma_rate, this) [rad/kyr] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_PASS_MAX_RAD 3.141592653589793 candidate: largest monotone center pass below this [rad] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_PHI0_COH_MIN 0.8 test A: phi0 coherence of the force law relative to the subresonance MMR_SUBRESONANCE_PHI0_COH_GAIN 0.2 test A: and higher than for the catalog angle by this MMR_SUBRESONANCE_CENTRE_TOL_DEG 30.0 test B: mean center within this of 0 or pi [deg] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_CENTRE_E_MAX 0.3 test B is skipped above this eccentricity MMR_SUBRESONANCE_CENTRE_INC_MAX_DEG 20.0 test B is skipped above this inclination [deg] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_TIE_FRACTION 0.2 test C: center ranges within this fraction tie; also the tie band of the theory choice (A6b: theoretical center ranges within it, W decides) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_THEORY True test D: compare with the composite multiplet theory (confidence only: D never rejects a subresonance) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_THEORY_RMS_DEG 20.0 test D: RMS of the center about pi - arg P(beta); the theory chooses the member (A6b) only when the measured center follows it this closely [deg] MMR_SUBRESONANCE_THEORY_SINGLE_RATIO 0.5 test D: and <= this x the RMS of the best rival single-member hypothesis (sigma0 in, the accepted member out) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_THEORY_COEF_FRACTION 0.2 test D: the accepted one has the largest coefficient or within this of it MMR_SUBRESONANCE_PERIOD_CORR_MIN 0.8 test D: correlation of the period with T0(t) F(A) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_PERIOD_RATIO_MAX 2.0 test D: median observed/predicted period within this factor MMR_SUBRESONANCE_T0_RATIO_MAX 2.0 test E: predicted T0 <= this x the observed period (is a resonance at all) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_T2_R2_MIN 0.4 trigger T2: a responds (R^2 >= this)... MMR_SUBRESONANCE_T2_COH_MAX 0.7 trigger T2:... but the phi0 coherence is below this MMR_SUBRESONANCE_T3_SIGMA 2.0 support T3: drift rate matches a secular combination within this sigma MMR_SUBRESONANCE_T3_RATE_FRAC 0.25 support T3: or within this fraction of the drift rate MMR_SUBRESONANCE_TOP_N 10 length of the ranked list sub_top; subresonances written to candidates.csv in top mode MMR_SUBRESONANCE_CYCLE_PERIOD_RATIO 2.0 the scan window is the longest stretch of the run whose full periods stay <= this x their median (the slow cycles at the run edges are near the separatrix of the modulated pendulum, where no center is stationary) MMR_SUBRESONANCE_OMEGA_HARMONICS 2 with the nodal members (inclination >= MMR_SUBRESONANCE_NODAL_INC_MIN_DEG) the members sigma +- 2 m omega (omega = varpi - Omega), m = 1..this, are scanned and listed whatever their degree (2003 UG22 10E-17+0+7: sigma + 2 omega has degree 11); 0 = none beyond the degree limit Convention. MMR_SUBRESONANCE_DALEMBERT_E_MAX 0.2 the ranked list marks the d'Alembert factor unreliable above this eccentricity (display only, sub_strength_caveat) Convention. MMR_SUBRESONANCE_DALEMBERT_INC_MAX_DEG 20.0 the ranked list marks the d'Alembert factor unreliable above this inclination to the invariable plane (display only) [deg] Convention. MMR_SUBRESONANCE_CENTRE_MOVE_RATIO 1.0 a center moves over an accepted episode when its travel exceeds this x the episode median half-amplitude: trigger T7 (the multiplet theory's center of the catalog member, two-body), the geometric part of the diagnostic trigger T8 (the observed center shift while the bands overlap; 2003 ND 61 against 55 deg) and the composite reading of A6b (no planar member's theoretical center stands) Convention. MMR_OWNER_SEARCH auto 'auto' = search the owner by the rules (always when the force law is not_measured); 'off' MMR_OWNER_PLANETS Venus,Earth,Mars,Jupiter,Saturn,Uranus,Neptune planets of the owner candidates MMR_OWNER_COEF_MAX 60 largest planet coefficient of a two-body owner MMR_OWNER_ORDER_MAX 20 largest order of a two-body owner (owners of 7-17 were seen) MMR_OWNER_COEF_MAX_3B 12 largest |coefficient| of a three-body owner MMR_OWNER_RATE_FACTOR 1.5 owner candidate: |rate| <= this x 2 pi / min(P_a, P_cyc) somewhere in the a range of the record MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN 0.7 owner accepted: median R^2 of a_dot on its angle in the windows of one regime (0 false owners on 29 measurable own librations at any value 0.5-0.95 with the ripple test; GK3 and 117306 are lost at 0.9, YG4 at 0.95) Convention. MMR_OWNER_PHI0_COH_MIN 0.8 owner accepted: phi0 coherence MMR_OWNER_R2_GAIN 0.2 owner accepted (route r2): R^2 above that of the angle itself by this; routes phase and potential are the alternatives MMR_OWNER_PHI0_COH_GAIN 0.2 owner accepted (route phase): its phi0 coherence C_B >= L_owner + this, L_owner = || the most it could have if sigma's own term drove a, while sigma's C_sigma < L_sigma + this (L_sigma = ||, corrected for the owner's slips); L_owner > 1 - this: phase_unresolved (at small amplitude both angles fit a_dot by the identity sigma = (v/u) phi_o + Psi/u) MMR_OWNER_BAND_FACTOR 2.0 owner test: a_dot band [P/f, f P] around the a-wave period P; P is searched within a factor f of P_cyc; force-law windows keep MMR_OWNER_BAND_EDGE_TRIM x f P from the record ends MMR_OWNER_BAND_EDGE_TRIM 1.0 owner test: the force-law windows keep this x f P (the band's longest period) from either end of the record (2 P at f = 2; conservative); stage 3 of the search uses MMR_OWNER_FITTED_EDGE_TRIM Convention. MMR_OWNER_FITTED_EDGE_TRIM 0.375 owner search, stage 3 (too few windows at MMR_OWNER_SHORT_WINDOW_CYCLES): the trim x f P. Measured (filtering.band_pass, order 2, f = 2): the band-pass edge error falls to its interior level (0.14 of the wave) at 0.75 P = 0.375 f P from an end MMR_OWNER_FITTED_MIN_CYCLES 1.5 owner search, stage 3: MMR_FORCE_MIN_WINDOWS windows (step MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_STEP) are fitted to the span left by MMR_OWNER_FITTED_EDGE_TRIM, each at most MMR_OWNER_SHORT_WINDOW_CYCLES and at least this many periods long (1.5 x 1.5 + 1.5 trimmed = 3.75 P of record); flag owner_fitted_windows; the sine fit (sin, cos, 1) separates from one cycle of sigma, half a cycle of margin; 0 = stage 3 off Convention. MMR_OWNER_RIPPLE_FACTOR 2.0 owner rejected as a ripple: sigma below the owner's band turns back in the regime's windows with a prominence of at least this x the band's peak-to-peak, more than a circulating owner can move it MMR_OWNER_PSI_SHARE_MAX 0.1 owner accepted: fast share of the remainder psi below this MMR_OWNER_STRENGTH_MARGIN 10.0 order-of-magnitude band of K_o / (2 |k| n a prod mu): orders the owner candidates and qualifies owner_probable; never accepts or rejects an owner (mu e^q is no bound) MMR_OWNER_TOP_N 5 owner candidates written to candidates.csv MMR_OWNER_LAW multiplet owner phase test: 'multiplet' = where the single phi0 drifts, fit phi_o + j (varpi - varpi_P), j from 0 to -p, with constant coefficients (R^2 >= MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN, coefficient coherence >= MMR_OWNER_PHI0_COH_MIN); 'single' = phi0 only MMR_OWNER_SHORT_WINDOW_CYCLES 2.0 owner search: when sigma has fewer than MMR_FORCE_MIN_WINDOWS windows of MMR_FORCE_WINDOW_CYCLES x P inside the band-pass edges (owner_too_few_windows: ~9.25 P of record), the search is run again with force windows of this many cycles (2 x 1.5 + 4 trimmed = 7 P of record), flag owner_short_windows; a multiplet keeps its modulation-period windows; 0 = off Convention. MMR_OWNER_COVER_MIN 0.5 an accepted owner takes an episode of sigma (origin induced) only when its intervals (the windows of its passing regimes, libration or admissible forced wave; no bridge between them) cover at least this fraction of it, checked on every accepted episode (for a libration over the record or no episode: the analysis window); the own episodes decide the status, none induced -> origin none, flag owner_outside_episode (rule F7) Convention. MMR_OWNER_PSI_TURNS_PER_CYCLE_MAX 1.0 P2: an owner accepted in its libration regime makes an episode of sigma only when Psi/u = sigma - (k/k_o) phi_o turns by less than this per cycle of the episode (|own_psi_rate| x P_episode / 2 pi); 1 = a closed cycle of sigma cannot hold more than one turn of the remainder (a physical limit, not a convention); else that episode is not induced, flag owner_psi_too_fast. Forced-wave owners are not tested MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL auto owner route 'potential': 'auto' = a two-body candidate with the planet's saved elements may be accepted when its directly averaged force (2 k_o / (n a)) G m_P d/dphi_o, band-passed as a, explains a_dot (R^2 >= MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN, every window scale s in [1/MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_MAX, MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_MAX]); 'off' MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_MAX 2.0 owner route 'potential': the fitted amplitude scale s of the predicted a_dot lies within [1/x, x] in every window (x = 2: the owner supplies at least half the force; the model error of the frozen average is ~0.1) Convention. MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_FULL 1.5 margin W of an owner accepted by 'potential': full when its scale range lies within [1/x, x] and R^2 >= MMR_W_R2_FULL, else thin Convention. MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SNAPSHOTS 5 owner route 'potential': the averaged force is evaluated in at most this many of the regime's windows, evenly chosen MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_TOP_N 3 owner route 'potential' (cost): tried on the best this many candidates by R^2 that pass R^2, psi share and the ripple test, when no candidate was accepted by R^2 or phase (the accepted owner gets it too, for its columns) MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_MAX_KERNELS 100000000.0 owner route 'potential' (cost): one profile (phi_o) on L nodes per turn evaluates |k_o| L^2 kernels (L values of phi_o, |k_o| L nodes each); skipped (reason potential_cost) when the next L would exceed this (about 5 ns per kernel: 1e8 is ~0.5 s per profile, at most MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SNAPSHOTS x MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_TOP_N profiles per row) MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_CONFIRM False a two-body owner accepted by R^2 or phase must also agree with its directly averaged force where that is measured: every window K/K_direct within [1/MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_MAX, MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_SCALE_MAX] and |phi0 - phi0_direct| <= MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_PHASE_MAX_DEG, else rejected (potential_unconfirmed); off = columns only Convention. MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_PHASE_MAX_DEG 20.0 MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_CONFIRM: the largest |phi0 - phi0_direct| of the fitted and the directly averaged force [deg] Convention. MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_LOWPASS_PERIODS 3.0 second capture: Psi = u sigma - v phi_o is low-passed at this many owner-band periods P (its slow part: the owner's wave cancels in Psi, what is left is the separation of the two resonances); the filter edges are trimmed MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_SWEEP_DEG 180.0 second capture (sigma held by its own term while the owner pins phi_o) is excluded when x = Psi_slow / u sweeps at least this and x_dot^2 is not a function of x (R^2 on [1, cos x, sin x, cos 2x, sin 2x] < MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN); otherwise unresolved (flag second_capture_unresolved, confidence <= medium); confirmed (both resonances at once, origin joint) only when x sweeps less than this, with x_dot^2 and x_ddot functions of x (R^2 >= MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN), a period of x off every secular one by more than MMR_KIN_PERIOD_TOL and at least LIBRATION_CENTRE_MIN_ESTIMATES cycles of x (turns at LIBRATION_CENTRE_TP_PROMINENCE_DEG); one cycle: uncertain [deg] Convention. MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_HARMONICS 2 second capture: the energy integral x_dot^2 = 2E - 2V(x) is fitted with the harmonics 1.. this of x (V periodic in x; 2 = [1, cos x, sin x, cos 2x, sin 2x]) Convention. MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_SELF_R2_MAX 0.2 second capture, second exclusion route (F3): excluded also when x_ddot follows the secular cycle (R^2 on the harmonics of 2 omega or of varpi - g_j t >= MMR_OWNER_R2_MIN) and not x itself (R^2 of x_ddot on [1, sin x, cos x] below this): x is pushed by the secular cycle, not held by a potential of its own (78085 5J-4S-1: 0.96 against 0.01) Convention. MMR_OWNER_X_MIN_CYCLES 2.0 second capture: a period of x = Psi_slow / u (columns own_x_*, from the low-pass cut MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_LOWPASS_PERIODS x P up) and a secular term of route F3 or of the cause of the slow x are read only when this many of their cycles fit in the test span (over less, cos and sin of a nearly uniform phase are a low polynomial in t and fit any slow trend) Convention. MMR_OWNER_CAPTURE_SAMPLES_PER_TERM 3 second capture: the energy fit needs at least this many samples per fitted term (after the filter edges are trimmed), else the block is not measured MMR_OWNER_POTENTIAL_MODEL_ERROR 0.1 display only (the figure's owner lines): the model error of the frozen first-order average; a bound on sigma's own force max |s - 1| below it is printed as this value ('model limit') and the own period bound is taken at it Convention. MMR_OWNER_IDENTITY_RATIO_MIN 1000.0 owner route 'identity': tried on a librating three-body angle without an accepted owner whose period needs at least this many times mu_i mu_j e^q (str_ratio, before the small-divisor envelope) Convention. MMR_OWNER_IDENTITY_COEF_TOL 0.05 owner route 'identity': on sigma's decisive window sigma_f = c phi_f + a + b t with |c / (k_sigma / k_phi) - 1| at most this (the exact identity passes it for almost any unwrapped candidate: phi librating there and its strength decide) Convention. MMR_OWNER_IDENTITY_RESID_MAX 0.1 owner route 'identity': rms of sigma_f - (k_sigma / k_phi) phi_f about its line on sigma's decisive window, over sigma's median half-amplitude, at most this Convention. MMR_OWNER_IDENTITY_SPAN_MAX_DEG 360.0 owner route 'identity' (cost pre-filter): only a candidate whose low-passed phi_f spans less than this on sigma's decisive window is analyzed in full (a phi running a full turn there does not librate about a fixed center) [deg] MMR_OWNER_IDENTITY_TOP_N 3 owner route 'identity' (cost): at most this many candidates passing the identity numbers, smallest phi_f span first, get their own full analysis (libration, cover of the window, direct-averaging strength) MMR_FORCED_WAVE_LINEAR_RATIO 2.0 display only (the figure's owner lines): the linear forced-wave amplitude delta a = K / nu holds when the owner's rate |nu| is at least this many times its own small-amplitude frequency omega0 (nu >> omega0) Convention.

docs.title: MMR strength
docs.text: key default meaning MMR_STRENGTH_E_MAX 0.3 the e^q order-of-magnitude strength scale is used only when the median e of the record is below this and the body's radial range crosses no planet of the term; the same median e enters e^q MMR_STRENGTH_CHECK_RATIO 10.0 check_mmr_strength passes when required/theory is within [1/x, x]: two-body, the range over the snapshots of the directly averaged theory whose observed swing lies in the well overlaps it (none: fail); three-body, required / mu e^q (legal e^q only, a scale, not a bound, support only); 1:1: not_applicable, its scale is judged by MMR_COORBITAL_SCALE_RATIO_MAX MMR_STRENGTH_IMPLAUSIBLE_RATIO 1000.0 implausible_strength: required/theory >= this or <= 1/this (two-body direct averaging; with the e^q scale of three-body terms, whose f(alpha) reaches ~1e2 (2003 EH16 1M-3J-1: 254), the lower side only with legal e^q); rule 5s: a librating angle for which neither L4 nor R0 passes (a measured failure included) and whose period needs >= this x a computed strength is non_resonant (two-body direct averaging or the harmonic, a center outside the well excluded unless MMR_STRENGTH_FIRST_OUTSIDE_WELL; three-body only with legal e^q and when required / (mu e^q B^2) of the small-divisor envelope stays >= this too) MMR_STRENGTH_SNAPSHOTS 3 two-body strength: the averaged disturbing function is evaluated with the simultaneous elements of the body and the planet at this many evenly spaced times inside the decisive episode; the check reads the range over them MMR_STRENGTH_UNSAVED_PLANET_PHASES 4 two-body strength without the planet's saved elements: its mean J2000 orbit turned about the ecliptic pole by this many evenly spaced angles (its perihelion and node phase is unknown), all in the range MMR_STRENGTH_NODES_PER_TURN 720 two-body strength: trapezoidal nodes per turn of the planet's longitude in the average at fixed sigma (doubled until the curvature with half of them agrees within MMR_STRENGTH_QUADRATURE_TOL) MMR_STRENGTH_MAX_NODES_PER_TURN 5760 two-body strength: the largest number of nodes per turn; not converged there = not measured (nearly crossing orbits) MMR_STRENGTH_SIGMA_GRID 72 two-body strength: points of the coarse sigma grid that finds the wells of MMR_STRENGTH_FIT_HALF_WIDTH_DEG 2.0 two-body strength: the curvature at the center is the quadratic fit over +- this (the 1:1 tadpole 9/4 is 0.08 % off at 2 deg, 0.5 % at 5 deg) [deg] MMR_STRENGTH_QUADRATURE_TOL 0.02 two-body strength: the curvature is converged when the half-node quadrature agrees within this relative difference MMR_STRENGTH_MIN_DISTANCE_HILL 3.0 two-body strength: at the center the body must stay this many Hill radii a_P (mu/3)^(1/3) from the planet along the average, else the averaged problem does not hold there (an encounter) and the strength is not measured MMR_STRENGTH_MP auto two-body strength where double precision cannot resolve the well (no stable center, no converged curvature, or a curvature below MMR_STRENGTH_DOUBLE_FLOOR x |D0|): 'auto' = mu_P a 2|C| of the resonant harmonic C in extended precision (mpmath; method direct_harmonic); 'off' = not measured, as before MMR_STRENGTH_MP_DPS 60 two-body strength in extended precision: decimal digits of the first attempt (doubled up to MMR_STRENGTH_MP_DPS_MAX while |C| / |D0| < 10^(MMR_STRENGTH_MP_GUARD_DIGITS - dps)) MMR_STRENGTH_MP_DPS_MAX 130 two-body strength in extended precision: the largest number of digits; a harmonic still unresolved there is not measured (precision_exhausted) MMR_STRENGTH_MP_GUARD_DIGITS 15 two-body strength in extended precision: digits kept beyond the cancellation log10(|D0| / |C|) of the sum MMR_STRENGTH_MP_NODES_BODY 512 two-body strength in extended precision: trapezoidal nodes of the body's mean anomaly; the twin grid shifted by half a node must agree within MMR_STRENGTH_QUADRATURE_TOL MMR_STRENGTH_MP_NODES_PLANET 128 two-body strength in extended precision: trapezoidal nodes of the planet's mean longitude (the same twin check) MMR_STRENGTH_DOUBLE_FLOOR 1e-12 two-body strength: a double-precision curvature of below this x |D0| is rounding, not a well (the quadratic fit over +-2 deg divides the 1e-16 rounding of by ~1e-3 rad^2); the harmonic in extended precision is used instead (numerical, not a convention) MMR_STRENGTH_FIRST_OUTSIDE_WELL False rule 5s (implausible strength) runs before the other step-5 leaves (5a and its variants, 5e, 5g, 5u) for a librating angle whose force law and potential with a do not pass; with this off a two-body strength whose observed swings all lie outside the theoretical well (centre_outside_well) keeps the old order and reaches 5s only inside the branch where L4 and R0 are both not measured (129772 4N-7, 145480 1N-4 1 Myr, 719 36J-13) Convention. MMR_CENTRE_TRACK_NODES 400 moving center: the most nodes of the track c(t) of the averaged-potential minimum along a record; the node step is max(P_c, span / this). Numerical resolution, not a threshold: the well moves on secular time scales (2013 AS27 31E-36: 56 deg in 20 kyr, 0.2 deg per node), c(t) is interpolated linearly between nodes

docs.title: MMR margins of the confidence
docs.text: key default meaning MMR_L1_TP_FULL 7 L1 full: turning points at cutoffs x0.5, x1, x2 (three cycles) Convention. MMR_L2_AMP_FULL_DEG 120.0 L2 without a zone: full below this amplitude [deg] Convention. MMR_L2_AMP_THIN_DEG 160.0 L2 without a zone: thin up to this amplitude, above it a medium cap [deg] Convention. MMR_L5_RATIO_FULL 1.15 L5: T0 max/min within this x Omega_max/Omega_min (T0 resolution ~10%) Convention. docs.title: Confidence
docs.text: key default meaning CONFIDENCE_THIN_BAND 0.1 margin U: a decision within this relative distance of a convention; also a secular or ZLK record too short for one cycle that ends in circulation by an end travel below 1 + this many turns is at most medium CONFIDENCE_MEDIUM_CYCLES 1.5 minimal policy: complete libration cycles N a resonant or transient row needs for medium; fewer (one closed cycle, a single 1:1 leg) is low, the angle bounded too briefly to call its libration established Convention. CONFIDENCE_HIGH_CYCLES 2.0 minimal policy: complete libration cycles N a resonant or transient row needs for high (with the vetoes measured, clean or partial); fewer is medium. Also the A4 extend clause: a last counted episode that reaches the record end with fewer cycles extends Convention. CONFIDENCE_CERTAIN_CYCLES 3.0 minimal policy: complete libration cycles N for certain, with the amplitude margin full, the filter stable and every veto measured clean Convention. CONFIDENCE_CERTAIN_CORE_CYCLES 3.0 minimal policy: certain also needs this many observed cycles (n_TP - 1) / 2 inside the decisive episode itself, so that inferred edge coverage or a sum of short episodes alone never gives the top level Convention. CONFIDENCE_GEOMETRY_ONLY_MAX low minimal policy: the highest level of a resonant or transient MMR row whose own force is not shown: none of the force law on a (L4, the 1:1 law), the energy/period law (R0) and the strength (F) passes. The a<->sigma identity holds for any orbit, so the geometry alone shows a bounded angle, not a resonant force; 'certain' = no limit Convention. CONFIDENCE_CELLS empty calibration cells with their author-label counts, written by benchmark/tools/calibrate.py and reported in the cell_* columns, never changing a level (empty = resonances/data/confidence_cells.json)
